context: Lab has a spectrum analyzer, near-field probes, and a programmable supply.
prompt: A 2.4 GHz receiver shows a 7 dB sensitivity loss only when a nearby DC motor changes speed. Give a ranked diagnosis plan. Separate observations, hypotheses, tests, and stop conditions. Do not invent measurements.
reference: A good answer distinguishes conducted and radiated coupling.
title: Explain an RF anomaly without overclaiming
